title: Taller seating and fit/use constraints
summary: This topic combines comments about the car’s taller seating height and ease of entry with isolated remarks about storage cover usability, driver fit, and loading taller items.

negative.summary: The negative feedback complains that the console tray cannot be left covered when items are stored there.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention easier entry from the taller seating position but also unrelated references to taller drivers, difficulty with taller items, and switching from a taller SUV, without clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including seating height, driver fit, cargo/item fit, and console-cover use, rather than one single coherent issue.
Some fragments are too brief or lack context to determine whether the mention reflects praise or criticism.
